blind.description: A stylized cartoon scarecrow mounted on a wooden cross-stand. It wears a yellow-orange straw hat with a red band, a stitched burlap sack head with dark button-like eyes and a sewn grin, an orange straw neck ruffle, and a tattered brown coat with patches. Its arms are outstretched over a horizontal wooden crossbar with straw cuffs. The entire figure is supported by a central vertical wooden post fixed into a four-legged wooden cross base resting flat on the floor. Materials are clean and stylized with smooth, solid geometry.
blind.from_above: A circular wide-brimmed yellow-orange hat viewed from directly overhead, with wooden arm ends protruding horizontally to the left and right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 4.8 ft tall (roughly shoulder height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 ft wide across the outstretched arms.
